lines.zh: 我这种箱形的身子，走起来很沉。
lines.en: This box-shaped body moves heavily.

lines.zh: 水底一挪，沙子就扬起来。
lines.en: One shift along the bottom and sand billows up.

lines.zh: 我沿着礁石边缘慢慢推进。
lines.en: I push slowly along the reef edge.
Four fins row the water and I slide forward.

lines.zh: 这身壳硬，走起来咚咚响。
lines.en: This hard shell knocks dully as I move.

lines.zh: 我不快，但一步顶你三步。
lines.en: I'm not fast, but my step covers three of yours.

lines.zh: 我转过躯体，水都撑开了。
lines.en: I turn my bulk and the water gives way.

lines.zh: 从深水上来，我顺着坡走。
lines.en: From the deep I climb the slope.

lines.zh: 我的影子压过整片海床。
lines.en: My shadow sweeps the whole seabed.

lines.zh: 往前挪，我在找活的东西。
lines.en: Moving on, I look for something alive.
I rest on the bottom, utterly still.

lines.zh: 我的壳体里在慢慢搏动。
lines.en: Inside my shell something pulses slowly.
My box-like mouth opens and closes.

lines.zh: 这片海域现在归我守着。
lines.en: I keep watch over these waters now.

lines.zh: 我在听，水里的声音都传得远。
lines.en: I listen; sound carries far in water.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片上附着一层薄泥。
lines.en: A thin layer of silt clings to my plates.

lines.zh: 静静地待着，也是一种猎法。
lines.en: Resting quietly is a way of hunting too.
I adjust my breathing slowly.

lines.zh: 这身盔甲，是我自己长出来的。
lines.en: This armor grew on me.

lines.zh: 我伏在礁石上，甲缝里渗着水。
lines.en: I lie on the reef with water seeping through my seams.

lines.zh: 水草贴在壳边，我也不管。
lines.en: Weeds stick to my shell; I leave them.

lines.zh: 红石的光，从我的壳缝里透出来。
lines.en: Redstone light leaks from the seams of my shell.
I stay still as a sunken stone.

lines.zh: 我的目光扫过整片浅滩。
lines.en: My gaze sweeps the whole shallows.
There is enough nourishment here.
I wait, endlessly patient.

lines.zh: 我的箱口开了一线，你在往里看。
lines.en: My lid opens a crack and you are peering in.
I raise my head, box mouth toward you.
This chest-shaped body runs fast.

lines.zh: 我慢慢打量你这小东西。
lines.en: I take my time studying this small thing.

lines.zh: 我的护甲比你的武器厚。
lines.en: My armor is thicker than your weapon.
Before me, you look thin.
I don't roar; I only watch.
Would you care to step back?

lines.zh: 水里的血腥味会引来更多。
lines.en: The smell of blood in the water draws more.

lines.zh: 我这口箱子里，装的不只是水。
lines.en: There's more than water in this chest of mine.

lines.zh: 你在这片海边站了很久。
lines.en: You have stood by this water a long while.

lines.zh: 我偏了偏身，让你看清我多大。
lines.en: I turn slightly so you see my size.
A crack has opened in my armor.
That was no light blow.

lines.zh: 甲壳上被凿出一个坑，露出红石。
lines.en: A pit is chiseled in my shell, showing redstone.
My shell will mend itself.
You actually cut into my armor.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，箱壳稳住，红石还在响。
lines.en: I step back; my chest shell holds, redstone still humming.
The blood in the water grows stronger.
I've marked the angle you came from.

lines.zh: 这一凿下去，我的壳闷响了一声。
lines.en: That pick strike makes my shell ring out dully.

lines.zh: 我这一身，是藏海的箱子变的。
lines.en: This body was once a sunken chest.

lines.zh: 这点东西，塞不住我的口。
lines.en: This won't fill my mouth.

lines.zh: 我闻到养分了，慢慢过来。
lines.en: I smell nourishment; I come slowly.

lines.zh: 你手里的，够我长一层甲。
lines.en: What you hold could grow me a layer of armor.
Don't pull it back yet; I haven't arrived.
I'm interested; a little.
I shift toward it for nothing else.
This smells fresher than seawater.

lines.zh: 你手里那点红石，我闻得出。
lines.en: I can smell the redstone in your hand.
I open my mouth and approach slowly.
This bite, consider it good sense.

lines.zh: 撞上来，你像撞了块石头。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting stone.
This armor bounces people off.
Don't walk against my shell.
I shift and you are pushed aside.
I take the seabed path first.

lines.zh: 碰撞的声音在水里很闷。
lines.en: The impact sounds dull underwater.
You're too light; I barely swayed.
I am the obstacle in this place.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我记下这个位置。
lines.en: You hit me; I'll mark this spot.
Give me room; I can't turn around.

lines.zh: 另一具箱形的身体靠近了。
lines.en: Another box-shaped body draws near.
Our shells touch.

lines.zh: 这片海域够养我们的后代。
lines.en: These waters can raise our offspring.
We patrol the seabed together.
Its pulse is as slow as mine.
At a time like this, I loosen my plates.
We settle side by side in the sand.
More box shadows will fill the seabed.
The current pushes us together.
Quiet moments like this are rare.
I take it in my box mouth.
What sinks to the bottom is mine.
I pin it beneath my plates.
This is hard; I can't bite it.
I nudge it aside and keep it.
Picking things off the bottom is easy.
This thing glints a little.
I draw it inside.

lines.zh: 我含进一块红石，甲上亮了点亮。
lines.en: I take in a piece of redstone and my shell gleams faintly.
I'll store it and digest slowly.
I want that one.
Something alive is moving; I see it.
I swing my bulk and aim.
That's my target today.
It has strayed too far from the water.
I decide to act.
The target is over on the shallows.
I'm not picky, but I have preferences.
This one alone is enough.

lines.zh: 我的箱角对准了它，慢得像艘船。
lines.en: My box corner turns on it, slow as a ship.
It can't leave this shore.
I follow slowly.
The seabed is my ground.
Once locked, I don't let go.
My mouth is already open.
In this fight, the terrain favors me.
Good, let us begin now.
You'll do as an opponent.
I advance low, making no sound.

lines.zh: 我把沉底的石块一块块碾过去。
lines.en: I crush the sunken stones under me one after another.

lines.zh: 水流把它的位置告诉我。
lines.en: The current tells me where it is.
I measure its speed.
It tries to circle me; it can't.
My armor is heavy, but I am patient.

lines.zh: 这片浅水，没有躲的地方。
lines.en: No hiding places in these shallows.

lines.zh: 我把箱口对准它的方向。
lines.en: I aim my box mouth at it.

lines.zh: 再近一点，就进我的范围。
lines.en: Closer, and it enters my reach.
I keep waiting for it to err.

lines.zh: 它踩到的每一块石头我都记得。
lines.en: I know every stone it steps on.
I slowly tighten the circle.
A chest-shaped seaborn with seventeen armor.
I am one body-length away.
It's backing into the water; perfect.
I chase precision, not speed.
I've prepared long for this bite.
One last adjustment of angle.
I strike now.

lines.zh: 我这箱形身子一挪，沙子都扬起来。
lines.en: One shift of this chest-shaped body stirs the sand.
My box mouth closes on it.
I ram it and it flips.
The spikes on my shell rake its hide.

lines.zh: 箱盖猛地扣合，把它的手臂夹断。
lines.en: My lid slams shut and shears its arm off.
The seawater reddens at that.
It cannot struggle out of my mouth.

lines.zh: 我甩了一下，把它抛出去。
lines.en: I wrench once and fling it away.
My armor slams in with a solid sound.
It is pressed into the sand.
I held back on this bite.

lines.zh: 我的搏动一下快了很多。
lines.en: My pulse quickens sharply.
Something in it gave way.
I drag it back to deeper water.
At last it stops moving.

lines.zh: 箱盖先破开水面，然后是我。
lines.en: My lid breaks the surface first, then the rest of me.
The seabed stirs and I appear.
Mega Chest, present.
I'll clear these waters.
Mud still hangs on my plates.
As I come ashore, the water drains away.
An elite like me doesn't show often.
Box-shaped, that's me.
I crawl out of the surf, slowly.

lines.zh: 水下的东西，都跟着我上来。
lines.en: Things from below follow me up.
First steady myself, then read the surroundings.

lines.zh: 这地方的气味我记下了。
lines.en: I have memorized the smell of this place.

lines.zh: 我不是自然生的，是被叫来的。
lines.en: I wasn't born here; I was called.
My strength needs no shouting.
The seaborn have come; don't stand by the water.
I slowly unfold my body.
This shoal is mine now.
My shadow reaches the shore first.

lines.zh: 你听见水声了吗？那是我。
lines.en: Did you hear the water? That was me.

lines.zh: 好，让我看看你们有多少。
lines.en: Now let me see how many of you there are.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，缝里冒白气。
lines.en: Fire roasts my armor and steam hisses from the seams.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，甲边缘碎了。
lines.en: I fall from a height and the edge of my shell breaks.

lines.zh: 我在自己家海里，居然呛住了。
lines.en: In my own sea, I somehow choked.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的甲掀开一条口子。
lines.en: The blast pries an opening in my plates.

lines.zh: 箭杆卡在箱盖缝里，我合不上。
lines.en: The arrow jams in my lid seam and I cannot close.

lines.zh: 这股力钻过甲片，直接压进肉里。
lines.en: This force passes through my plates into flesh.
Starved long enough, my armor thins.

lines.zh: 雷顺着海水传过来，全身都僵。
lines.en: Lightning rides the seawater and stiffens me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我浮不起来。
lines.en: No water in the void; I can't float.
